capabilities.title: Bubblewrap Namespace Sandbox Backend
theory: 代码-code/从零构建Astra与Codex级系统/教程-lessons/14-受限进程沙箱与真实隔离边界-process-sandbox.md
代码-code/从零构建Astra与Codex级系统/教程-lessons/15-Docker容器隔离与逃逸负测试-container-sandbox.md
evidence: Bubblewrap 0.9.0 backend and command contract exist: minimal root view, workspace bind/ro-bind, capability drop, explicit environment and optional network unshare
GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 blocks required namespace operations: observed RTM_NEWADDR Operation not permitted for isolated loopback setup and Permission denied while setting up uid map

Sandbox security CI therefore hard-checks policy construction but explicitly skips runtime namespace cases that the host kernel policy cannot execute; no unavailable capability is converted into a false validation
next: run host-secret/filesystem/network escape tests on a self-hosted kernel that permits unprivileged user namespaces
compare bubblewrap policy with container backend behavior
add syscall policy and explicit filesystem capability model

capabilities.title: Docker Container Sandbox for Agent Command Execution
theory: 代码-code/从零构建Astra与Codex级系统/教程-lessons/15-Docker容器隔离与逃逸负测试-container-sandbox.md
智能体-agent/07-评测安全与开放问题-agent-evaluation-safety.md
Codex源码解剖-codex-anatomy/03-工具执行审批与沙箱-tools-approval-sandbox.md
evidence: Sandbox security workflow run 6 passed both jobs on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04; Docker container job passed 7 escape-oriented tests and Ruff

Tested runtime: Docker Engine 28.0.4, containerd 2.3.4, runc 1.5.1, python:3.12-slim registry digest sha256:78387bc3881b8273120a12ebe6c1ab22b018ccc2c9adf565ae1ac9b536e184ea, local image id sha256:ec7d6c95cd3692a2e2d228a8b1ca74e4025b54121fcc4c5da6f09cfa473315ad

Behavioral tests validate host-secret invisibility, declared workspace write, read-only workspace/rootfs rejection, --network none isolation from host loopback, parent-secret environment non-inheritance, CapEff=0 and NoNewPrivs=1
Validated claim is limited to this Docker/shared-kernel threat model; it is not VM-grade hostile-code containment and does not claim resistance to kernel or container-runtime vulnerabilities
next: pin immutable image digest in runtime policy
artifact-only output mode and per-path write capabilities
